question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

I was __astonished__ to know the truth.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Stunned**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"astonished"** means greatly surprised or impressed; amazed. (चकित)

 
 
• **Example: **She was **astonished **to see the beautiful decorations at the party.
 
 
 
• **"Stunned" **refers to being so shocked that one is temporarily unable to react; astonished. (अचम्भित)
 
 
• **Example: **He was **stunned** by the sudden turn of events.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the synonym of **'astonished'** is **'stunned'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Awesome **(अद्भुत): Extremely impressive or daunting; inspiring great admiration.

 
 
• **Example:** The view from the top of the mountain was simply awesome.
 
 
 
• **Blindsided **(अप्रत्याशित): To be caught unprepared by something; to be surprised in a negative way.
 
 
• **Example: **He was blindsided by the sudden job termination.
 
 
 
• **Sickened **(घिनौना): To feel disgusted or appalled.
 
 
• **Example:** She was sickened by the sight of the accident.
